measurement_basis: complete repository test suite, real-provider persistence proof, and live authority-event projection

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment authority events and environmental-capability projection

request.vertical_proof_result: PASS: real provider invocation, protected-write denial, checkpoint, new-process resume, cross-consumer handoff, and completion

outcome.verified_behavior: Authority denial, escalation, and scoped integration-preflight events now attach stable campaign and WorkIntent identities when available. The session-activity projection validates and preserves those references, marks missing or invalid historical WorkIntent references explicitly, and retains the identities in compact output. Canonical README and RFC guidance now match the existing claim-free merge/publish eligibility policy. A real preflight was projected under the new WorkIntent while retaining the overlap count and truncation boundary.
outcome.verification_limit: The real preflight establishes eligibility and objective correlation only. It did not execute Git integration. Automated tests establish the event and projection contract; they do not measure whether agents discover the capability more easily or whether coordination overhead falls over time.

related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

agent discovery or usability improvement across other WorkIntents or consumers
long-term change in authority-related coordination overhead
